title: The Mathematics Universe
subtitle: Engineering Mathematics Core and Beyond
author: Golam Kuadir Khan Prince
description: A 25-chapter engineering-mathematics core, nine specialization tracks, a research frontier and an appendix of proofs, with Desmos graphs and crafted figures.

levels.name: Core
levels.blurb: The original 25 chapters: the engineering-mathematics foundation every track builds on.

levels.name: Specializations
levels.blurb: Tracks A–I. Each track has its own prerequisite graph; read the ones you need, in any order.

levels.name: Research Frontier
levels.blurb: Track J. Deeper territories to explore as your interests develop.

tracks.title: The Mathematics Behind Algorithms
tracks.blurb: How to make programs faster, prove they work, and understand the limits of computation.

chapters.title: The Mathematics of Algorithms
chapters.explores: Asymptotic analysis, Big-O/Theta/Omega, recurrences, amortized analysis, algorithmic lower bounds, and complexity trade-offs.
chapters.challenge: Why can an algorithm that is faster on small inputs become terrible on large ones?

chapters.title: Graph Theory: The Mathematics of Connections
chapters.explores: Paths, trees, flows, matchings, connectivity, graph coloring, planar graphs, network centrality, spectral graph theory.
chapters.challenge: How would you find the best route, match thousands of people, or detect hidden communities?

chapters.title: Combinatorics: Counting the Impossible
chapters.explores: Permutations, combinations, inclusion–exclusion, recurrence relations, generating functions, pigeonhole principle, Ramsey theory, extremal combinatorics.
chapters.challenge: How can a problem have more possible configurations than atoms in the observable universe?

chapters.title: Discrete Mathematics and Computational Logic
chapters.explores: Propositional and predicate logic, induction, relations, sets, discrete structures, Boolean algebra, invariants, proof techniques.
chapters.challenge: How do you prove that a program must work for every valid input?

chapters.title: The Limits of Computation
chapters.explores: Automata, formal languages, Turing machines, decidability, computability, reductions, P versus NP, and undecidable problems.
chapters.challenge: Are there problems that no computer program can ever solve?

tracks.title: Probability, Uncertainty, and Information
tracks.blurb: The mathematics of randomness, prediction, communication, and decision-making under uncertainty.

chapters.title: Probability: The Science of Uncertainty
chapters.explores: Conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, independence, inequalities, limit theorems.

chapters.title: The Art of Counting Random Worlds
chapters.explores: Advanced combinatorics, random variables, distributions, tail bounds.

chapters.title: Information Theory: Measuring the Unknown
chapters.explores: Entropy, mutual information, KL divergence, coding, compression.

chapters.title: Random Walks and Markov Worlds
chapters.explores: Markov chains, stationary distributions, mixing times, hitting times.

chapters.title: Bayesian Thinking and Statistical Inference
chapters.explores: Bayesian inference, likelihood, estimators, hypothesis testing, model selection.

chapters.title: Stochastic Processes: When Randomness Evolves
chapters.explores: Poisson processes, Brownian motion, martingales, stochastic calculus.

chapters.title: Causal Inference: Correlation Is Not Destiny
chapters.explores: Causal graphs, interventions, counterfactuals, confounding, experimental design.

chapters.title: Monte Carlo: Computing with Randomness
chapters.explores: Sampling, simulation, variance reduction, Markov chain Monte Carlo.

tracks.title: Game Theory and Strategic Intelligence
tracks.blurb: What happens when the thing you are optimizing against can think back.

chapters.title: Game Theory: When Rational People Clash
chapters.explores: Normal-form games, dominant strategies, Nash equilibrium.

chapters.title: The Prisoner's Dilemma and Other Traps
chapters.explores: Cooperation, repeated games, social dilemmas, evolutionary stability.

chapters.title: Games with Incomplete Information
chapters.explores: Bayesian games, beliefs, signaling, screening.

chapters.title: Mechanism Design: Engineering Incentives
chapters.explores: Social choice, incentive compatibility, truthful mechanisms.

chapters.title: Auctions, Markets, and Strategic Bidding
chapters.explores: Auction formats, revenue, allocation, market design.

chapters.title: Coalitions, Voting, and Collective Decisions
chapters.explores: Cooperative games, Shapley value, voting systems, bargaining.

chapters.title: Evolutionary Games and the Mathematics of Survival
chapters.explores: Replicator dynamics, evolutionary stable strategies, population games.

chapters.title: Adversarial Decision-Making
chapters.explores: Minimax, zero-sum games, regret, robust strategies.

tracks.title: Optimization and Operations Research
tracks.blurb: From introductory engineering tools to the advanced frameworks that schedule, route and control the world.

chapters.title: Convexity: The Geometry of the Best Answer
chapters.explores: Convex sets/functions, separation theorems, convex optimization.

chapters.title: Duality: Solving Problems from the Other Side
chapters.explores: Lagrangian duality, KKT conditions, sensitivity analysis.

chapters.title: Integer Programming and Combinatorial Optimization
chapters.explores: Integer models, branch-and-bound, cutting planes, relaxations.

chapters.title: Operations Research: Mathematics That Runs the World
chapters.explores: Scheduling, inventory, logistics, resource allocation.

chapters.title: Optimal Control: Choosing the Best Future
chapters.explores: Dynamic optimization, Pontryagin's principle, control constraints.

chapters.title: Dynamic Programming and Bellman's Principle
chapters.explores: Bellman equations, optimal policies, state-space methods.

chapters.title: Reinforcement Learning Through Mathematics
chapters.explores: Markov decision processes, value functions, policy optimization.

chapters.title: Robust and Stochastic Optimization
chapters.explores: Uncertain parameters, chance constraints, worst-case optimization.

chapters.title: Optimal Transport and Wasserstein Geometry
chapters.explores: Transport plans, Wasserstein distances, distribution matching.

tracks.title: The Abstract Mathematics Behind Everything
tracks.blurb: The common structures hiding beneath seemingly unrelated problems.

chapters.title: Abstract Algebra: Symmetry as a Language
chapters.explores: Groups, rings, fields, homomorphisms, quotient structures, group actions, and symmetry. Applications: cryptography, coding theory, geometry, physics.

chapters.title: Number Theory: The Hidden Arithmetic of the Digital World
chapters.explores: Primes, modular arithmetic, congruences, Diophantine equations, finite fields, elliptic curves, computational number theory. Applications: cryptography, pseudorandom generators, error-correcting codes.

chapters.title: Topology: What Survives When Shapes Bend?
chapters.explores: Continuity, compactness, connectedness, homeomorphisms, fundamental groups, homology, topological data analysis. Applications: geometry, robotics, data analysis, dynamical systems.

chapters.title: Differential Geometry: Mathematics on Curved Worlds
chapters.explores: Manifolds, tangent spaces, differential forms, curvature, geodesics, tensors, Riemannian geometry. Applications: robotics, computer graphics, mechanics, relativity.

chapters.title: Real Analysis: Making Calculus Rigorous
chapters.explores: Limits, continuity, sequences, series, metric spaces, completeness, measure, integration, convergence theorems. Applications: probability theory, optimization, mathematical proof.

chapters.title: Functional Analysis: Infinite-Dimensional Thinking
chapters.explores: Normed and Banach spaces, Hilbert spaces, operators, dual spaces, spectral theory, weak convergence. Applications: quantum mechanics, PDEs, signal processing, inverse problems.

chapters.title: Category Theory: Mathematics About Mathematics
chapters.explores: Categories, functors, natural transformations, universal properties, limits, adjunctions. Applications: type theory, programming language design, abstract algebra, compositional systems.

chapters.title: Abstract Linear Algebra: Vectors Without Coordinates
chapters.explores: Vector spaces over arbitrary fields, linear maps as the primary objects, dual spaces, quotients, direct sums, invariant subspaces, Jordan and rational canonical forms, multilinear forms. An independent advanced module bridging the core linear algebra chapters to functional analysis, representation theory and tensors.

tracks.title: Logic, Proofs, and the Foundations of Truth
tracks.blurb: For writing reliable algorithms, designing programming languages, and understanding why some truths cannot be proved.

chapters.title: How to Think Like a Mathematician
chapters.explores: Direct proof, contradiction, induction, construction, counterexamples.

chapters.title: Set Theory and the Infinite
chapters.explores: Cardinality, ordinals, countability, uncountability, axioms.

chapters.title: Mathematical Logic and Formal Systems
chapters.explores: Predicate logic, completeness, soundness, compactness, incompleteness.

chapters.title: Type Theory and the Curry–Howard Connection
chapters.explores: Types as propositions, proofs as programs, dependent types.

chapters.title: Formal Verification: Proving Programs Correct
chapters.explores: Hoare logic, invariants, model checking, theorem provers.

chapters.title: Paradoxes, Independence, and Mathematical Limits
chapters.explores: Russell's paradox, Gödel's incompleteness theorems, independence results.

tracks.title: Mathematics for Computer Graphics, Games, and Simulation
tracks.blurb: The geometry, algebra and numerics that turn equations into worlds on a screen.

chapters.title: The Mathematics of 3D Worlds
chapters.explores: Coordinate systems, affine transformations, homogeneous coordinates, projections.

chapters.title: Quaternions and the Geometry of Rotation
chapters.explores: Rotation groups, quaternion algebra, interpolation, rigid-body transforms.

chapters.title: Ray Tracing: The Geometry of Light
chapters.explores: Rays, intersections, reflection, refraction, sampling, rendering equations.

chapters.title: Numerical Simulation and Physics Engines
chapters.explores: Numerical integration, collision detection, constraints, stability, error.

chapters.title: Fractals: Infinite Complexity from Simple Rules
chapters.explores: Iterated functions, self-similarity, fractal dimensions, chaotic sets.

chapters.title: Procedural Generation: Creating Worlds with Rules
chapters.explores: Noise functions, random fields, cellular automata, grammars, spatial structures.

chapters.title: Computational Geometry: Algorithms for Shapes
chapters.explores: Convex hulls, triangulation, Voronoi diagrams, spatial indexing.

chapters.title: Signal Processing for Audio and Visual Computing
chapters.explores: Sampling, filtering, convolution, transforms, spectral analysis.

tracks.title: Cryptography, Coding, and Digital Security
tracks.blurb: Mathematics against adversaries and noise. Correct mathematics alone does not guarantee a secure implementation.

chapters.title: Cryptography: Mathematics Against Adversaries
chapters.explores: Security definitions, symmetric encryption, public-key cryptography.

chapters.title: Elliptic Curves and Modern Cryptographic Mathematics
chapters.explores: Finite fields, elliptic-curve groups, discrete logarithms.

chapters.title: Error-Correcting Codes: Recovering the Lost
chapters.explores: Hamming distance, linear codes, cyclic codes, Reed–Solomon codes.

chapters.title: Coding Theory Meets Information Theory
chapters.explores: Channel capacity, entropy, coding bounds, compression.

chapters.title: Pseudorandomness and Computational Indistinguishability
chapters.explores: Randomness tests, pseudorandom generators, computational security.

chapters.title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs and the Mathematics of Trust
chapters.explores: Interactive proofs, commitment schemes, proof systems.

tracks.title: Dynamical Systems, Chaos, and Complexity
tracks.blurb: Tools for epidemics, ecosystems, power grids, neural networks, traffic, and emergent behavior in games.

chapters.title: Dynamical Systems: Rules That Create Motion
chapters.explores: State spaces, fixed points, stability, phase portraits.

chapters.title: Chaos Theory: When Tiny Changes Become Huge
chapters.explores: Sensitivity, Lyapunov exponents, strange attractors.

chapters.title: Bifurcations: When Systems Change Their Nature
chapters.explores: Stability transitions, bifurcation diagrams, nonlinear behavior.

chapters.title: Cellular Automata and Emergent Worlds
chapters.explores: Local rules, global patterns, computational universality.

chapters.title: Network Science: The Shape of Complex Systems
chapters.explores: Random networks, scale-free networks, contagion, synchronization.

chapters.title: Complexity Science: When the Whole Exceeds the Parts
chapters.explores: Emergence, self-organization, feedback, adaptive systems.

tracks.title: Mathematics at the Frontier
tracks.blurb: Not prerequisites for every programmer: the deeper territories to explore as your interests develop. The frontier is open-ended.

chapters.title: Partial Differential Equations Beyond the Basics
chapters.explores: Weak solutions, boundary-value problems, regularity.

chapters.title: Spectral Theory: Understanding Operators Through Their Modes
chapters.explores: Eigenfunction expansions, operator spectra, applications to PDEs.

chapters.title: Inverse Problems: Reconstructing the Invisible
chapters.explores: Parameter estimation, regularization, ill-posed problems.

chapters.title: Mathematical Physics: The Structure Behind Nature
chapters.explores: Variational principles, symmetries, Hamiltonian mechanics.

chapters.title: Tensor Mathematics and Multilinear Algebra
chapters.explores: Tensor products, multilinear maps, tensor decompositions.

chapters.title: Algebraic Geometry: Solving Equations Through Shapes
chapters.explores: Polynomial varieties, ideals, coordinate rings.

chapters.title: Representation Theory: Making Abstract Symmetry Concrete
chapters.explores: Group representations, characters, irreducible structures.

chapters.title: Mathematical Economics and Social Choice
chapters.explores: Equilibrium, preference relations, welfare, voting theory.

chapters.title: Measure Theory and Modern Probability
chapters.explores: Sigma-algebras, measures, Lebesgue integration, convergence.

chapters.title: Mathematical Research: How New Mathematics Is Created
chapters.explores: Conjectures, counterexamples, proof strategy, literature exploration.
